decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight sits squarely within the firm's existing track-system knowledge, and it has had its own page for two years, so the firm can read its results and improve it easily.
The ceiling luminaire line is core to the firm's competence and has been presented consistently in both years, so related knowledge supports continued refinement.
The flexible LED spotlight builds directly on the firm's spotlight and track expertise and has a dedicated page, so it fits the existing knowledge base well.
The multi-outlet canopy is an accessory that extends the modular system and draws on known installation knowledge, which makes it cheap to keep and supportive of luminaire sales.
The low-voltage canopy complements the low-voltage systems the firm already understands, though its niche scope adds slight uncertainty.
The glass track luminaires stay close to the core offer, but being only mentioned rather than featured gives the firm weaker signals to learn from, so the risk of dropping them is somewhat higher.
